# Week 3 Start/Sit Briefing — Wednesday, 2026-09-23 (fifth version)

## Source and freshness

**Not live for projections.** Built from `weekly-report-week-3.json` as regenerated at 21:24 UTC with the blend fix (`2f04572`), the injury-source fix (`fc4de02`) and the depth-chart fix (`3c854cc`), plus FantasyPros consensus and ESPN injuries. Live nflreadpy practice data covers only Atlanta and Green Bay.

**Why there are five versions:** v1 used projections deflated about 3x, because the report never gave the blend model its usage stats. v3 fixed that but let nflreadpy's partial week-3 report (ATL/GB only) wipe ESPN's injury designations for every other team. v4 fixed that but still read every starting WR2 and WR3 as a backup, because nflverse's 2025 depth-chart feed ranks receivers across the whole position instead of within a slot. That cut Higgins, Golden and Williams to 82-84% to play instead of 95.5%. This version has all three fixes.

## Practice report

No rostered player is on any Week 3 report yet; only ATL and GB have filed. London and Golden are absent from those two reports, meaning no concern was listed.

| Player | Designation | Source | P(play) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jaxson Dart | **Out for the season**: knee surgery | ESPN via CI | 0.003 |
| Brock Bowers | **Questionable**: knee, meniscus (upgraded from Out) | ESPN via CI | 0.463 |

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | @DEN (Sun 8:20pm) | **14.20** | 95.8% | 14.83 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs HOU | **17.71** | 93.3% | 18.99 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs MIN | **15.88** | 93.3% | 17.02 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | @WAS | **20.53** | 95.5% | 21.51 |
| WR | Tee Higgins | @PIT | **12.50** | 95.5% | 13.09 |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | vs TEN | **10.46** | 92.6% | 11.29 |
| FLEX | Cam Skattebo | vs TEN | **11.76** | 93.3% | 12.61 |
| FLEX | Matthew Golden | vs ATL (Thu 8:15pm) | **11.75** | 95.5% | 12.31 |
| K | Cameron Dicker | @BUF | **4.16** | 97.9% | 4.25 |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | @CHI (Mon 8:15pm) | **4.73** | 100.0% | 4.73 |

**Lineup total (expected): 123.68**

**Sit:** Dart (season over — move to IR), Downs (11.39), London (10.82), Williams (10.57), Bowers (6.19, Questionable).

## Changes since Monday

- **Stafford for Dart.** Dart is expected to need season-ending knee surgery. Move him to IR; that frees a bench spot for a backup QB, which you now need.
- **Higgins for Williams.** 12.50 against 10.57 expected (13.09 vs 11.07 if they play). Williams has 13 targets and 6.9 points a game this season; Higgins has 16 and 11.7.
- **Everything else holds from Monday**, including Golden at FLEX. He edges Downs by 0.36 and plays Thursday.

## Still uncertain

- **Bowers**: LV's Thursday/Friday practice reports decide the TE slot. A full practice by Friday puts him ahead of Likely.
- **The FLEX tier** (Skattebo, Golden, Downs, London) spans under a point. Treat the order as soft.

## Byes ahead

None in Weeks 3–4. Nearest: Dicker, Week 7.
